text:
It was an age when only the dead

could smile, freed from wars;

and the emblem, the soul of Leningrad,

hung outside its prison-house;

and the armies of captives,

herded in the railroad yards,

escaped from the song sung by the whistle of the

engine,

whose refrain went: Go away, pariahs!

The stars of death hung above us.

And Russia, the innocent, the beloved, writhed

under the tracks of boots stained with blood,

under the wheels of the Black Marias.

translation.title: Prologue
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the Requiem prologue's historical scale, prison-house image, and Black Maria vans.
